AlphaGenome motif-importance analysis

EVN, SVN, and EVS | held-out chr2 | real genomic backgrounds

1 Scope

This report summarizes motif-level interpretation of the final AlphaGenome models trained through chrX. Attribution is calculated across every held-out chr2 test sequence. Region selection uses TF-MoDISco seqlet calling with a 21-bp attribution window and 10-bp flanks on each side (41-bp returned seqlets). The 200 strongest regions are selected with equal representation from the four combinations of class label and attribution sign (50 regions per stratum). Each selected region is compared with four class- and length-matched control windows and evaluated with 20 dinucleotide-shuffle ablations.

HOCOMOCO v14 CORE clustered motifs provide non-redundant labels. Motif labels are the closest TOMTOM matches to attributed regions; they are model-based annotations and do not establish transcription-factor occupancy in vivo.

DeepLIFT failed its summation-to-delta audit for all three AlphaGenome classifiers because the backbone contains operations without valid DeepLIFT rules. The workflow therefore selected saliency automatically. Prediction parity between the wrapped and native model was exact for every task.

7 Interpretation

EVN and SVN provide the strongest basis for biological hypothesis generation because their held-out classification performance and saliency–ISM agreement are high. EVS can still reveal potentially interesting sequence features, but its more modest predictive performance makes those findings exploratory.

Repeated motif families across tasks are candidates for shared regulatory grammar. Task-restricted clusters are candidates for task-specific mechanisms, but their apparent absence elsewhere is conditional on the top-200 candidate design. Ablation estimates how editing a selected region changes the model prediction; the important region label additionally requires that effect to exceed matched controls after multiple-testing correction. Neither result establishes TF binding or causal regulation in cells.

8 Reproducibility

Analysis provenance
Item Value
Models Final through-chrX AlphaGenome heads for EVN, SVN, and EVS
Evaluation chromosome chr2 held-out test sets
Attribution screen Saliency over every test sequence
Candidate panel TF-MoDISco seqlet selection; top 50 regions per label × attribution-sign stratum (200/task)
Perturbation 20 dinucleotide-shuffle ablations plus four matched controls per candidate
Motif database HOCOMOCO v14 CORE clustered (648 representative motifs)
Motif annotation Nearest TOMTOM match
Random seed 42
